::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Founded 2022 in Hyderabad (IIIT-Hyderabad incubation; CEO Dr Madhav Pulipati) to build photonic chips for quantum-safe communication; QKD receiver chip taped out by December 2023. Through the Luminate accelerator it moved its headquarters and optical manufacturing to Rochester, New York (Oct 2025), and has an office in Eindhoven. Kept here as Indian-founded; India operations to be re-checked.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Photonic integrated circuits for quantum key distribution (QKD) transmitters/receivers and quantum random-number generation.
